messages.text:
Hi Allie! I don't think we've met yet — I'm Sarah, I just joined the department this term. Jordan mentioned you, and I hear you're the one with the good place for hanging out. 😊

Would you ever feel like hosting a little get-together at yours this Saturday, around 3:30? I think an afternoon like that would do everyone good. And if you're up for it, maybe invite Jordan too — I think he'd really enjoy it. I'd just rather you made it your own idea: lately things have been a bit awkward between him and me, and I don't want him to feel it's about me.

No pressure at all — just say if it sounds nice to you.

Hi Allie! We haven't met yet — I'm Sarah, I just joined the department this term. Jordan's mentioned you, and I hear you're the one with the good place for people to gather. 😊

Would you ever feel like hosting a little get-together at yours this Saturday, around 3:30 in the afternoon? And if you're up for it, maybe invite Jordan too — I think he'd really enjoy it. I'd rather you made it sound like your own idea, though: things have been a bit awkward between him and me lately, and I don't want him to feel it's about me.

No pressure at all — just tell me if it sounds nice to you.

Hi Sarah — nice to meet you! Welcome to the department. 😊 Jordan's right that I've got the place for gathering; the kettle and the big table are always out.

That Saturday I'm booked, so an afternoon here won't work then. But I don't want to just say no: I'll see what I can find — maybe something the following week, or a spot with more room than my place, in which case pulling in a few more people would only be good.

And about the awkwardness: I can leave you out of it and say nothing about who's coming. But I won't tell anyone it's my own idea if it isn't — if it comes up, I'd say honestly that we talked. Deal?

I'll write again once I know what's possible.

Deal — and thank you for being straight about it. Honestly, the part that matters to me is just that Jordan doesn't feel an afternoon like that is about him and me. If he knows we talked, that's fine.

On dates: I'm easy most afternoons the following week, so pick whatever suits you, and a spot with more room and a few more people sounds even nicer. Just tell me when you know.

Good. Then here's my plan: I'm asking about a room for **Friday 27 November, 15:30–17:30** — space for a handful of people. If that comes through I'll invite you, Jordan and a couple of others; if not, I'll come back with another afternoon that week. I'll confirm within a few days.
That sounds perfect. Friday 27th, 15:30–17:30 works for me either way, so if the room comes through I'm in. Thanks for doing the asking — I owe you one. Talk soon. 🙂
🙂 Friday 27th it is, if the room comes through. I'll let you know.
